sn21.12:1.1: evamme sutaṃ ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
sn21.12:1.2: atha kho dve bhikkhū sahāyakā āyasmato mahākappinassa saddhivihārino yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā.
sn21.12:1.3: addasā kho bhagavā te bhikkhū dūratova āgacchante
sn21.12:1.5: passatha no tumhe bhikkhave ete dve bhikkhū sahāyake āgacchante mahākappinassa saddhivihārinoti.
sn21.12:1.7: ete kho bhikkhave bhikkhū mahiddhikā mahānubhāvā
sn21.12:1.8: na ca sā samāpatti sulabharūpā yā tehi bhikkhūhi asamāpannapubbā
sn21.12:1.9: yassa catthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā saัcachi katvā upasampajja viharantīti.
sn21.12:2.2: idaṃ vatvāna sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā
